tagline.en: San Francisco to New Jersey along the emigrant road
tagline.zh: 从旧金山到新泽西，沿着西部移民之路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 加利福尼亚州旧金山，与 US 101 相接

end.en: I-95 at the New Jersey Turnpike, Teaneck, New Jersey
end.zh: 新泽西州蒂内克，与新泽西收费高速的 I-95 相接

en: I-80 crosses eleven states from the Pacific to the Hudson, and for most of that distance it is following a line that people were already following on foot. West of Salt Lake City it traces the emigrant road — the Oregon and California Trail corridor across the Great Basin, up the Truckee River, over the Sierra crest near Donner Pass. East of the Missouri it picks up the Platte River route, then the Lincoln Highway, then a chain of turnpikes into the New York metropolitan area.

The road changes character more sharply than almost any other Interstate. In Nevada and Wyoming it runs for hours between towns, high and dry and wind-scoured, with snow gates and chain-up areas. Across Nebraska and Iowa it is farmland. Through northern Illinois and Indiana it becomes a tolled, truck-dominated industrial corridor. Its last few dozen miles are New Jersey suburban freeway, ending at a Turnpike interchange within sight of Manhattan.

It is also the road the trucking industry actually uses. I-80 is the northern transcontinental freight line, and in winter its mountain passes are the chokepoints that decide whether freight moves between the coasts at all.
zh: I-80 自太平洋横贯十一个州直抵哈德逊河，而其中大部分路段所循的路线，早已有人徒步走过。在盐湖城以西，它沿着移民之路而行——即穿越大盆地、上溯特拉基河、在唐纳山口附近翻越内华达山脊的俄勒冈小径与加利福尼亚小径走廊。密苏里河以东，它接上普拉特河路线，继而是林肯公路，再接一串收费公路进入纽约都会区。
这条路性格变化之剧烈，在州际公路中几乎无出其右。在内华达与怀俄明，它连开数小时不见城镇，地势高、气候干、长风不断，沿途设有雪闸与装防滑链的路肩。跨过内布拉斯加和艾奥瓦是农田。穿过伊利诺伊北部与印第安纳，它变成一条收费的、以卡车为主的工业走廊。最后几十英里则是新泽西的郊区高速，终点是一处望得见曼哈顿的收费高速互通立交。
它也是货运业真正在用的那条路。I-80 是北方的横贯大陆货运干线，冬季里它的山口就是瓶颈——货物能否在两岸之间流动，往往取决于这几处山口。

en: The Sierra Nevada crossing is the defining piece of engineering. The old US 40 and Lincoln Highway route went over Donner Pass itself, on curves too sharp for Interstate standards. Planners moved the freeway about two miles north to Euer Saddle — signed by Caltrans as Donner Summit — which is slightly higher but far wider, with approaches gentle enough to hold a steady grade of three to six percent for thirty miles. The ten-mile stretch over the summit was finished in 1964.

The result is a mountain crossing that stays open nearly all winter, plowed rather than closed. Before I-80, the high route shut regularly and traffic detoured far north over Beckwourth Pass. That change is the single largest improvement the Interstate made to trans-Sierra travel, and it is the reason the freight line runs where it does.

At the other end the road inherits rather than builds. Much of I-80 east of Chicago is pavement laid by toll authorities in the 1950s, absorbed into the system with its bond debt and its service plazas intact.
zh: 内华达山脉的穿越是这条路最具代表性的工程。原先的 US 40 与林肯公路是直接翻越唐纳山口本身的，弯道太急，达不到州际公路标准。规划者把高速公路北移约两英里，改走 Euer Saddle——加州交通厅在路牌上称之为唐纳顶（Donner Summit）——那里海拔略高，但地形开阔得多，进出坡道足够平缓，可以在三十英里内保持百分之三到六的稳定纵坡。翻越山顶的那十英里路段于 1964 年完工。
由此得到的是一处几乎整个冬天都通行的山口：靠除雪维持，而不是靠封闭。在 I-80 之前，这条高线路段经常关闭，车流要远绕北面的贝克沃思山口。这是州际公路给跨内华达山脉交通带来的最大改善，也正是货运干线走在今天这个位置的原因。
在路线的另一端，这条路更多是继承而非新建。芝加哥以东的 I-80 有很大一部分是 1950 年代由收费公路管理机构铺设的路面，连同其债券债务与服务区一起被并入系统。

en: I-80 was numbered in the first plan for the Interstate System and built westward and eastward from the middle over three decades. Wyoming finished its share — the longest high-altitude stretch on the route — in May 1977, opening the last eight miles at Cheyenne and giving drivers an unbroken run from New Jersey to Echo Canyon in Utah.

The final gap was in Utah, on the western edge of Salt Lake City near the airport. A short section between Redwood Road and 5600 West opened to traffic on a Sunday in August 1986 and was dedicated five days later. With that, I-80 became the first transcontinental Interstate completed end to end — a fact the Federal Highway Administration noted was achieved about fifty miles from Promontory Summit, where the transcontinental railroad had been joined in 1869.

Nothing about the route has stayed still since. The Bay Area approaches, the Chicago-area tollways and the New Jersey end have all been rebuilt or widened, and the mountain sections are managed as much by weather operations as by pavement crews.
zh: I-80 在州际公路系统的首个编号方案中即已定名，随后三十年间由中段向东西两侧推进施工。怀俄明州于 1977 年 5 月完成本州路段——全线最长的高海拔区间——在夏延通车最后八英里，使司机可以从新泽西一路畅行到犹他州的埃科峡谷。
最后一处缺口在犹他州，位于盐湖城西缘机场附近。红木路（Redwood Road）与 5600 West 之间的一小段于 1986 年 8 月的一个星期日通车，五天后举行落成仪式。至此，I-80 成为第一条全程贯通的横贯大陆州际公路——联邦公路管理局特别指出，这一节点距离 1869 年横贯大陆铁路接轨的普罗蒙特里顶约五十英里。
此后这条路从未静止。湾区的引道、芝加哥一带的收费高速、以及新泽西一端都经过重建或拓宽，而山区路段的管理，靠气象调度的程度与靠路面班组的程度相当。

en: Unusually for an Interstate, I-80 has a published route-wide construction cost. At the 1986 dedication of the final Utah section, the Federal Highway Administration put the figure at $3.2 billion for the whole 2,907-mile road it then described, linking the George Washington Bridge to the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge.

That number should be read for what it is: a contemporaneous federal accounting in 1986 dollars, covering thirty years of construction by eleven states under a programme that paid ninety percent of eligible costs from the Highway Trust Fund. It does not include the toll-road mileage that was built with bond money before the Interstate programme existed, and it does not include anything spent since.
zh: 与多数州际公路不同，I-80 有一份公开的全线建设造价。1986 年犹他州最后一段落成时，联邦公路管理局给出的数字是：当时所述的这条全长 2,907 英里、连接乔治·华盛顿大桥与旧金山—奥克兰湾区大桥的公路，造价 32 亿美元。
这个数字应当按其本意来读：它是 1986 年由联邦作出的当期核算，以当年美元计价，涵盖十一个州三十年的施工，而当时的计划由公路信托基金支付合格费用的九成。它不包含在州际公路计划出现之前、以债券资金修建的收费公路里程，也不包含此后的任何支出。

why.en: Counts are published segment by segment by eleven state DOTs, and on this route they span from a few thousand vehicles a day in the Nevada and Wyoming basins to well over a hundred thousand in the Bay Area and northern New Jersey. No agency publishes a route-wide figure.
why.zh: 交通量由十一个州的交通部门按路段发布，而本路线的差距极大——从内华达、怀俄明盆地每日数千辆，到湾区与新泽西北部每日远超十万辆。没有任何机构发布全线数字。

timeline.en: I-80 is numbered in the first plan for the Interstate System.
timeline.zh: 州际公路系统首个编号方案中，I-80 获得编号。

timeline.en: The ten-mile section over Donner Summit opens, replacing US 40 as the trans-Sierra route.
timeline.zh: 翻越唐纳顶的十英里路段通车，取代 US 40 成为跨内华达山脉的路线。

timeline.en: Wyoming opens its final eight miles at Cheyenne, completing the route from New Jersey to Echo Canyon, Utah.
timeline.zh: 怀俄明州在夏延通车最后八英里，本路线自新泽西至犹他州埃科峡谷贯通。

timeline.en: The last section opens near Salt Lake City airport; I-80 becomes the first transcontinental Interstate finished end to end.
timeline.zh: 盐湖城机场附近的最后一段通车，I-80 成为第一条全程贯通的横贯大陆州际公路。
